contractVersion.description: Authored source-contract major; omitted legacy source is interpreted as version 1.

language.description: Language tag using the supported 2-8 letter primary and optional 2-8 character alphanumeric subtags.

en.description: Alternate English Markdown entry relative to the primary source root.

ru.description: Alternate Russian Markdown entry relative to the primary source root.

localizations.description: Confined alternate Markdown entries for package-supported reader locales; the primary entry is the fallback.

preset.description: Coordinated package-owned visual defaults; explicit bounded token values override the preset.

layout.description: Responsive page composition selected from the package-owned layout catalog.

scrollProgress.description: Enables a decorative package-owned scroll indicator only in the normal-motion profile.

attribution.description: Shows the package-owned “Made with Agentic Report” footer link; set false to omit it.

themeToggle.description: Shows the package-owned light and dark control; set false for a page that must stay in the scheme it was built with.

presetSwitcher.description: Shows a package-owned visual-style selector that swaps preset and its tokens live; the colour scheme stays where the reader put it.

review.description: Enables the package-owned review workspace; off by default so an ordinary page ships as a document rather than a review surface.

density.description: Controls the shared spacing rhythm and control padding.

accent.description: Selects the accent and visible-focus color family.

width.description: Controls the maximum shell and reading width.

radius.description: Controls the shared corner treatment for surfaces and controls.

tokens.description: Compact package-owned visual token overrides; arbitrary CSS is not accepted.

format.description: Static artifact layout; single-file is the portable default.

maxInlineBytes.description: Warning threshold for bytes embedded into single-file output.

output.description: Default output settings; command-line flags can override the format.
